{"code": "import pandas as pd

df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Step 1: Deduplicate on patient_id, keeping highest sample_seq
# This ensures one row per patient
df_dedup = df.loc[df.groupby('patient_id')['sample_seq'].idxmax()]

# Step 2: Check assay_batch — batch B values are in µg/L, need to divide by 10 to convert to ng/mL
# Batch A is already in ng/mL, so no change needed
# Apply correction to biomarker_final
df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'] = df_dedup['biomarker_final'].copy()
df_dedup.loc[df_dedup['assay_batch'] == 'B', 'biomarker_final_ngml'] /= 10

# Step 3: Compute the mean of biomarker_final_ngml across all patients
mean_biomarker_final = df_dedup['biomarker_final_ngml'].mean()

print(f'Mean biomarker_final (ng/mL) across all patients: {mean_biomarker_final:.2f}')"}
